item.title: Police investigate burglary of storage unit, seek stolen taxidermy trophies
item.description: CAPE GIRARDEAU, Mo., (KBSI) — The Cape Girardeau Police Department is investigating a burglary involving a storage unit where multiple taxidermy game trophies were reported stolen. item.title: SEMO to host K12TechPro NEXT Day focused on emerging education technology
item.description: CAPE GIRARDEAU, Mo., (KBSI) — Southeast Missouri State University will host K12TechPro NEXT Day on Friday, Feb. 20, bringing regional educators together to explore emerging technology trends in K-12 education. item.title: Marshall County awarded $850,000 grant to renovate senior citizens facility
item.description: BENTON, Ky., (KBSI) — The Marshall County Fiscal Court has been awarded an $850,000 Community Development Block Grant to renovate the county’s senior citizens facility, officials announced. item.description: CAMPBELL, Mo., (KBSI) — The Campbell Volunteer Fire Department responded to a structure fire at approximately 6:30 a.m. Tuesday.
